column1: RETIRED 2026-08-01 — this file is read by nothing.
The colour vector moved to  theme/colors.json
WHY, in Michael's words: "any clearer way to edit the values than the TSV
which is dense prose when in edit mode? at least with JSON i get the variable
He is right, and the rule the move produced is this:
A TABLE you read ACROSS stays a grid.   themes.tsv, contrast.tsv
A RECORD you edit one at a time is JSON. the four vectors
A palette is fifteen tokens times two modes. As a TSV row that is thirty
anonymous values in tab-separated sequence — correct, diffable, and unreadable
in an editor where the header has scrolled off the top and the only way to know
which value you are changing is to count columns.
KEPT AS A STUB, NOT DELETED, because three files pointed here this morning.
A 404 teaches nothing; this does. The values are in git history.
🚫 Do not put values back in this file. Two places to set a colour is the
exact defect the move was made to remove.
